pretreatments.description: Basic pretreatment: addition of 2 N NaOH to pH 12, followed by neutralization with 2 N HCl
Salt pretreatment: addition of 5 g/L of FeSO_4, MnSO_4, FeCl_3 or CaCO_3, followed by pH adjustment with 2 N HCl or NaOH
Ultrasonic pretreatment: application of 1.8 kW power in an ultrasonic bath
Combined pretreatment: ultrasonic pretreatment combined with FeSO_4, FeCl_3 or CaCO_3 pretreatment
